features.title: Compose bounded replay with exact-version durable queue and quarantine
features.acceptance: One shared lock-held queue primitive preserves B03 physical-scope/final-payload confirmation and elapsed guard, exact-version merge/ACK/quarantine and private atomic writes. Frozen upstream evidence remains byte-identical. Regression controls and Node22 clean install/lint/verify/test/build are recorded; no claim of native CI or release acceptance.

features.title: Independent cross-family acceptance of the combined candidate
features.acceptance: Fresh different-model-family evaluator independently checks the exact committed candidate against the spec using focused adversarial and real multiprocess controls, records an immutable verdict and limitations. Native Windows/Linux/PG16 and production gates remain explicit if not exercised; no self-signoff.
